scripts.dev: bun run package && bun run --filter "playground-*" dev
scripts.dev:svelte: bun run package && cd packages/playground-svelte && bun run dev
scripts.dev:solid: bun run package && cd packages/playground-solid && bun run dev
scripts.build: bun run package && bun run --filter "playground-*" build
scripts.build:svelte: bun run package && cd packages/playground-svelte && bun run build
scripts.build:solid: bun run package && cd packages/playground-solid && bun run build
scripts.check: vp check && bun run lint:svelte && bun run package && bun run --filter "./packages/*" check
scripts.check:svelte: bun run package && cd packages/playground-svelte && bun run check
scripts.check:solid: bun run package && cd packages/playground-solid && bun run check
